help.head:
How to fly

Every project on the site stands here as a slide; its chapters, documents and repositories are the points under it. Pick anything in the tree on the left, click a slide or a point, or take the tour.

  • Drag to turn round, scroll or pinch to come closer, shift and drag to slide sideways.
  • W A S D fly forward, back and sideways, Q and E sink and rise, while the 3D view has the keyboard.
  • In the tree: arrows move, Enter flies, right and left open and close, and typing finds a row.

The buttons

  • Contents: Shows or hides the tree of everything you can fly to.
  • ‹: The tour's previous stop.
  • Tour: Start or stop the tour: every slide in the front page's order.
  • ›: The tour's next stop.
  • Whole site: Fly back to see the whole site. The page stays as it is.
  • ?: Help: how to fly, and where the page view is.
  • Show tree: Show the tree again.
  • Previous: The previous item in this part of the tree.
  • Next: The next item in this part of the tree.
  • Copy link: Copy a link that opens on this item.

The same projects, chapters and documents are on the page view, which needs no 3D.
